title: FOLLIE: Automated Reasoning over the First Dataset of Sentences with their First-Order Logical Representation for French
abstract: arXiv:2611.02129v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: FOLLIE (for First-Order Logic for Language Inference and Entailment for French) connects French sentences, compositional first-order representations and automated natural language inference (NLI). The first French NLI-ready, NL-to-FOL resource, it contains 19,983 inference records and 36,987 non-empty sentence-slot--formula mappings from six heterogeneous NLI sources, retaining French lexical material and source problem structure. Its silver annotations are produced by a neural--symbolic pipeline, with 111 separately identified LLM-assisted additions. The construction combines morphosyntactic analysis, probability-conditioned categorial multitagging, grammatical proof search, discourse representation and first-order semantic construction. Stage-wise experiments show substantial gains in derivation coverage; analyses of conjunction distributions, logical-operator incidence and scope alternation characterise the resulting resource. translated_title: FOLLIE：面向法语的首个句子及其一阶逻辑表示数据集上的自动推理
translated_abstract: FOLLIE（面向法语语言推理与蕴含的一阶逻辑）将法语句子、组合式一阶逻辑表示和自动化自然语言推理（NLI）连接起来。作为首个面向法语NLI的、从自然语言到一阶逻辑（NL-to-FOL）的资源，它包含来自六个异构NLI数据源的19,983条推理记录和36,987个非空的句子-槽位-公式映射，保留了法语的词汇材料和源问题的结构。其银标注由一个神经-符号流水线生成，其中另有111条被单独标识的LLM辅助添加内容。该数据集的构建结合了形态句法分析、概率条件下的范畴多标注、语法证明搜索、篇章表示以及一阶语义构建。分阶段实验显示推导覆盖率有显著提升；对连词分布、逻辑算子出现率以及辖域交替的分析刻画了所构建资源的特性。
tldr: FOLLIE是首个面向法语NLI的自然语言到一阶逻辑资源数据集，包含近2万条推理记录，通过神经-符号流水线构建并显著提升了逻辑推导覆盖率，实现了对法语句子的一阶逻辑自动推理。
en_tdlr: FOLLIE is the first NL-to-FOL resource for French NLI, comprising nearly 20K inference records built via a neural-symbolic pipeline that substantially improves derivation coverage for automated first-order reasoning over French sentences.
